description: This file defines the 'KpiSaveController' class, which manages the preparation and rendering of KPI (Key Performance Indicator) related Vue components for creating or editing KPIs within the OrangeHRM performance module.

classes.name: KpiSaveController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling KPI save operations, extending the AbstractVueController and utilizing traits for KPI services.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component ('kpi-edit' or 'kpi-save') based on request parameters, adding relevant properties such as KPI ID or default ratings.
